title: YouTube to Cloud Storage with FlashData
description: Get your FlashData API key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys (sign in or create an account first). For a new download, enter one video ID, your FlashData API key and your cloud storage JSON below. Click Start, then check OUTPUT for status and jobId; completed delivery appears in the Dataset. To check an existing job, use the last section instead. New downloads use FlashData Credits; Apify resources and your cloud storage are billed separately.

video_id.title: Video Id
video_id.description: Paste one 11-character YouTube video ID. For https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abcdefghijk, copy only abcdefghijk (illustrative ID; replace it with your video). Full URLs and lists are not accepted.

flashdataApiKey.title: Your FlashData API key
flashdataApiKey.description: Get your key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys (sign in or create an account first), then create or copy a key with YouTube to Cloud Storage (youtube_download) permission. Paste the full key starting with fd_ here, without quotes or a Bearer prefix. Use your own FlashData key, not your Apify token. This field is encrypted; no working key is provided. Starting a new download uses your FlashData Credits; reading an existing job does not submit another paid download.

storageJson.title: Customer storage configuration (encrypted JSON)
storageJson.description: Required for a NEW download. Paste your storage configuration as JSON in this encrypted field. S3 example (replace all placeholders): {"storage_type":"s3","storage_url":"YOUR_BUCKET","access_key":"YOUR_ACCESS_KEY","secret_key":"YOUR_SECRET_KEY","region":"us-east-1"}. storage_url is the bucket/container name; use object_prefix for a folder. Supported providers: S3, S3-compatible, GCS, Azure, OSS, COS, BOS and TOS; credential fields vary by provider (see README). Never paste credentials into other fields. Clear this field when reading an existing job.

download_type.title: Download Type
download_type.description: Choose video with audio (audio_video), video only (video), or audio only (audio). For a first video download, keep audio_video and leave advanced format settings empty.

video_quality.title: Video Quality
video_quality.description: Video quality constraint. Omit for audio-only downloads.
video_quality.sectionDescription: Leave these empty or unchanged for a first download. Format, quality and clip settings must match the selected download type.

fps.title: Fps
fps.description: Frame-rate constraint. Omit for audio-only downloads.

audio_language.title: Audio Language
audio_language.description: Audio language selection; omit for video-only downloads.

audio_quality.title: Audio Quality
audio_quality.description: Applies only to audio downloads; omit for video or combined media.

yt_dlp_format.title: Yt Dlp Format
yt_dlp_format.description: Advanced format selector; overrides quality, FPS and audio-language selection.

upload_metadata.title: Upload Metadata
upload_metadata.description: Also upload metadata to your customer storage.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: Video: mp4, webm, mkv. Audio: m4a, mp3, opus. Omit to use the type-specific default.

start_at.title: Start At
start_at.description: Optional start timestamp in HH:MM:SS, at most 12:00:00.

end_at.title: End At
end_at.description: Optional end timestamp after start_at, in HH:MM:SS.

jobId.title: Continue an existing job (optional)
jobId.description: Reads this existing job without submitting or charging for a new download. Clear video_id and storageJson when using this field.
jobId.sectionDescription: Use this instead of starting another download: copy jobId from the previous run’s OUTPUT, keep your API key, and clear video_id, storageJson and any explicit download settings. Reading an existing job does not submit another paid download.

waitSeconds.title: Maximum polling wait (seconds)
waitSeconds.description: Stop polling after this interval. A pending job continues on FlashData; resume with jobId. The final in-flight API read can take additional time.
